about: Canned requests to the brain and the tool calls the orchestrate skill should lead to. Run on the NUC with `make -C plugins/marcel/tools test-live` (tests/test_skills_eval_live.py). `answers` are the canned tool results; `expect` lists calls that must appear in this order (argument values match when the expected text is in the actual value, ignoring case); `forbid` lists tools that must not be called.
